exception_examples:
Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will not finance new coal power plants."
Examples of evidence that would NOT trigger this exception: - "The bank will not finance new and existing coal power plants."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "No project finance to enable the construction or material expansion of thermal coal-fired power plants. Material expansion relates to absolute global increases rather than increases as a result of mergers or acquisitions."
mitigant_examples: Examples of evidence for this mitigant: - "The bank will not provide finance for expansions to existing thermal coal-fired power plants. This includes expansion via corporate mergers and acquisition unless the client has confirmed phase-out of these assets will be line with the bank's 2030/40 timelines."

exception_examples: Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will not participate in project finance for unabated fossil fuels." - "The financing of coal plant modernisation projects is assessed on a case-by-case basis. Factors such as life extension, decommissioning and conversion, reduction of pollutant emissions through improved filters and Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage technologies are taken into account." - "The bank will not provide finance for expansions to existing thermal coal-fired power plants (except for the purpose of retrofitting an asset to materially reduce greenhouse gas emissions) ."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will not provide finance for expansions to existing thermal coal-fired power plants where such expansion was not already either: (a) contractually committed (via power purchase  agreement for thermal coal-fired power generation); or (b) under construction, in each case before 01 January 2021."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "With regard to the construction of new coal-fired power plants, only development projects with a capacity of more than 300 MW are considered." - "Restricted activities:  New thermal coal-fired power plant. Excluded from this restriction are thermal coal-fired power plants dedicated to a specific project, such as an aluminium smelter or a steel mill."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: "No project finance to enable the construction or material expansion of thermal coal-fired power plants. Material expansion refers to an investment to increase net operational thermal power capacity by more than 10%."
